init_LocoGetMemoryHandler: create a LocoGetMemoryHandler instance with a speaker name and action dictionary for interpreting dialogue
handle_task_refobj_string_name: call handle_task_refobj_string with refobj_attr name to get the target object name response
handle_task_refobj_string_location: call handle_task_refobj_string with refobj_attr location to get the target location tuple response
step_GetMemoryHandler: call step on a GetMemoryHandler to process GET_MEMORY dialogue and delegate to reference object or task handlers
do_answer_GetMemoryHandler: call do_answer on a GetMemoryHandler with memory nodes and values to generate a response for the agent
